text: MGS, Seguros y Reaseguros S.A. is a Spanish insurer whose 40 million registered shares are not traded on any organised stock market. Its largest shareholder is the Fundación Mutua General de Seguros with 19.01% of the capital (2025); the Fundación also acts as depositary of the shares of private shareholders who chose to deposit them. Share transfers require board authorisation, including where the acquirer would control more than 3% of the company. No state, fund or other controlling shareholder is named in the company's own documents.
short: MGS Seguros: unlisted S.A.; largest stake 19.01% held by the Fundación Mutua General de Seguros; no controlling owner named.

source.name: MGS Seguros, Informe Anual Individual 2025 (annual report, audited by Forvis Mazars)
source.note: Company's own annual report. Notes section a. 'Capital social' states the share capital and that the shares are not listed; the Fundación Mutua General de Seguros holding and its depositary role follow in the same section. Statutes (ESTATUTOS_MGS_MARZO_2025.pdf, mgs.es) confirm the 3% transfer-authorisation rule and that the company is the matriz of Grupo MGS.
source.quote: Todas las acciones confieren los mismos derechos políticos y económicos y no tienen cotización en mercado bursátil organizado. La Fundación Mutua General de Seguros tiene una participación significativa del 19,01% del capital

additionalSources.name: MGS Seguros, Estatutos sociales (Articles of association, in force from 27 March 2025)
additionalSources.note: Company's registered statutes: shares are registered (nominativas), transfers need Consejo de Administración authorisation, with the >3% control clause cited; the company is the entidad matriz del GRUPO MGS.
additionalSources.quote: En el caso de que, como consecuencia de la adquisición proyectada, el adquirente llegara a controlar, directa o indirectamente, un porcentaje superior al 3% del capital de la Compañía.
